parameters.query:
WITH provided_token AS (
    SELECT NULLIF($1::TEXT, '') AS token
),

review_record AS (
    SELECT
        a.id::TEXT AS approval_id,
        a.decision_token,
        a.decision,
        a.requested_at,
        a.expires_at,
        a.decided_at,

        cv.id::TEXT AS campaign_version_id,
        cv.version_number,
        cv.generation_type,
        cv.model_name,
        cv.prompt_version,
        cv.content,
        cv.validation_status,
        cv.created_at AS version_created_at,

        c.id::TEXT AS campaign_id,
        c.campaign_code,
        c.product_service,
        c.target_audience,
        c.offer,
        c.objective,
        c.brand_tone,
        c.status AS campaign_status,

        cl.id::TEXT AS client_id,
        cl.client_code,
        cl.name AS client_name,
        cl.company_name,
        cl.email AS client_email,
        cl.website

    FROM approvals a

    JOIN campaign_versions cv
        ON cv.id = a.campaign_version_id

    JOIN campaigns c
        ON c.id = cv.campaign_id

    JOIN clients cl
        ON cl.id = c.client_id

    CROSS JOIN provided_token p

    WHERE a.decision_token = p.token

    LIMIT 1
)

SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN r.approval_id IS NULL
            THEN FALSE

        WHEN r.decision <> 'pending'
            THEN FALSE

        WHEN r.expires_at <= NOW()
            THEN FALSE

        ELSE TRUE
    END AS is_valid,

    CASE
        WHEN r.approval_id IS NULL
            THEN 'invalid_token'

        WHEN r.decision <> 'pending'
            THEN 'already_decided'

        WHEN r.expires_at <= NOW()
            THEN 'expired'

        ELSE 'valid'
    END AS review_status,

    CASE
        WHEN r.approval_id IS NULL
            THEN 'This review link is invalid.'

        WHEN r.decision <> 'pending'
            THEN 'A decision has already been submitted for this campaign version.'

        WHEN r.expires_at <= NOW()
            THEN 'This review link has expired.'

        ELSE 'The review link is valid.'
    END AS status_message,

    COALESCE(
        TO_JSONB(r),
        '{}'::JSONB
    ) AS review_data

FROM provided_token p

LEFT JOIN review_record r
    ON TRUE;

parameters.responseBody:
={{
  {
    success: $json.is_valid,
    review_status: $json.review_status,
    status_message: $json.status_message,

    campaign: $json.is_valid
      ? {
          id: $json.review_data.campaign_id,
          code: $json.review_data.campaign_code,
          company_name:
            $json.review_data.company_name,
          client_name:
            $json.review_data.client_name,
          product_service:
            $json.review_data.product_service,
          target_audience:
            $json.review_data.target_audience,
          offer:
            $json.review_data.offer,
          objective:
            $json.review_data.objective,
          brand_tone:
            $json.review_data.brand_tone
        }
      : null,

    version: $json.is_valid
      ? {
          id:
            $json.review_data.campaign_version_id,
          number:
            $json.review_data.version_number,
          model:
            $json.review_data.model_name,
          created_at:
            $json.review_data.version_created_at,
          expires_at:
            $json.review_data.expires_at
        }
      : null,

    content: $json.is_valid
      ? $json.review_data.content
      : null
  }
}}
